idle: Keep the candle low. Things here like the light.
I can hear Wren breathing. Slow. Good.
This floor goes on longer than it should.
My stitches itch. Is it the damp, or is it something watching?
Whatever we do, we do not stop for long.
Someone sewed these walls shut a long time ago.
hurt: I'm coming apart at the seam. Mend me when you can.
Don't wait for me. Wait, no. Do wait for me.
My stuffing is showing. That isn't good, is it?
dark: I can't see your face anymore.
If something touches my hand, tell me it's you.
shadow: Count the footsteps. Go on, count them.
tug: Something has my thread. It's pulling.
Give it something before it takes something.
whirr: A needle going up and down, somewhere ahead. Fast.
mannequins: They moved. I didn't see them move, but they moved.
Don't look at their faces. They haven't got any.
wren: Wren is scared. I can feel the floor shaking.
Hush now, Wren. We're still here.
curio: Well? Are we touching it or not?
I don't trust anything left out on purpose.
Whoever left this wanted it found.

warden: Stay behind me. That's what I'm stuffed for.
seamstress: Every tear can be mended. Almost every tear.
tinker: Hear that ticking? Not me. Not this time.
scarecrow: I've frightened worse than this. I think.
rag_duelist: If it bleeds thread, I can cut it.
yarn_ranger: I've marked the way back. Mostly.
lantern_monk: Light is borrowed. Spend it carefully.
